Photos 9 (a) to (c): CCTV Screenshots Showing Internal Condition of Lift L15 on 23/F

31. Another CCTV footage showed a ██████████ believed to be ██████████████████████████ inside lift L13 of Wang Tai House at about 1521 hours5. When the lift doors opened on 24/F, heavy and dense black smoke were also captured to be pouring intensely into the lift (as shown in Photos 10 (a) to (c)).

5 Although the CCTV footage was time-stamped at 1519 hours, it was approximately 2 minutes behind the HKO reference time, making the actual time approximately 1521 hours.
